# ramble_resource (Data Source)

Look up a pack or job in a Ramble registry by namespace and name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ramble_resource" "mysql" {
  namespace = "alice"
  name      = "mysql"
}

output "mysql_latest_version" {
  value = data.ramble_resource.mysql.latest_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the pack or job.
- `namespace` (String) Username or organisation that owns the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `description` (String) Short description.
- `file_path` (String) Path of the pack or job inside the repository.
- `id` (String) Ramble's numeric id of the resource.
- `latest_version` (String) The latest version Ramble knows of.
- `license` (String) Licence identifier.
- `repository_url` (String) Git repository the content is fetched from.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags.
- `type` (String) Either `pack` or `job`.
- `webhook_url` (String) URL the repository calls to publish new versions.
